Yenna is a Human and potential Camp Follower living in Rivington with her mother and her cat,  Grub.

Involvement

Yenna approaches the party as they enter Rivington for the first time. She explains her mother has gone missing and would like help finding her. The party can choose to give Yenna some money or food, suggest they find a guard to help her, tell her her mother is likely dead, or leave.

Regardless of the option chosen, Yenna shows up at the Campsite with Grub and asks if they can stay there. There are dialogue options to accept her into the camp, or kick her out.

Rescue Orin's Victim

Main article: Rescue Orin's Victim

If none of the candidate companions are at camp when  Orin kidnaps someone, Yenna is taken instead. If kidnapped, her cat Grub is killed and cooked on a skewer by Orin. To ensure that Yenna is not kidnapped, it is necessary that least one of  Lae'zel,  Gale,  Halsin or  Minthara is at camp after finding out about a shapeshifter infiltrating the camp. Otherwise Yenna can be kidnapped.

If Lae'zel is kidnapped, Yenna may be murdered by Orin in Lae'zel's form if the kidnapping occurs at camp and the player character fails to pass a speech skill check to stop her. If the skill check is succeeded, Yenna is shaken by the events, but recovers quickly and starts to sell soup at camp.

Companion approval

When first meeting Yenna:

  • Do not help Yenna  -1,  -1,  -1,  -1 and  -1  +1  +1
  • Help Yenna  +1,  +1; this may also trigger a conversation if he is in your party.
  • Give Yenna coin or food  +1  +1  +1 +1
  • Any choice  +1

Speak with Dead

Yenna can be spoken to with  Speak with Dead.

  • Yenna... I didn't want this to happen.
    • Narrator
      The corpse doesn't speak
  • Who can I inform of your death?
    • Yenna
      Grub... and you...
  • Where are you from?
    • Yenna
      Outer... city... Baldur's Gate...
  • What can I do to honor your memory?
    • Yenna
      Eat... lots...
  • What did you want to be when you grew up?
    • Yenna
      A cook... like... mummy...
  • Why did this happen?
    • Narrator
      The corpse remains silent. It does not know.
